instructions.question: buy, sell, or hold {{asset}}?
instructions.goal: One maker quote for this book and this inventory. hold means no new order.
instructions.inputs: state is a short line of adjectives in a fixed order: spread depth flow tape inventory funding clock. inventory is {{stance}}.
instructions.context: size, price, time in force and leverage are chosen by the code, never by you.

criteria.buy: Maker edge to lift or cover a short without chasing a violent tape.
criteria.sell: Maker edge to hit or reduce a long without chasing a dump.
criteria.hold: No edge, hostile book, or inventory already expresses the view.

instructions.question: Is this book too hostile to send any non-reduce order?
instructions.inputs: state is the same short line of adjectives. inventory is {{stance}}.
instructions.context: Answer yes only for a book where a resting quote would be obvious food.

criteria.true: Unfillable book, bot_war plus violent tape, or funding extreme against the would-be add.
criteria.false: A resting post-only quote can be placed without being obvious food.
